描述_EN: the fushun mines were historically significant and this poster probably refers to an actual visit made by mao in order to demonstrate his camaraderie with his people. posters helped to propagate the cult and here he is seen literally in the fore. mao zedong's personal aim behind the cultural revolution was to bolster his own position within the communist party. chairman mao badges offered a means for people to 'own' the cult and demonstrate their allegiance.
描述_ZN: 抚顺矿区具有重要的历史意义，这张海报可能是指毛泽东的一次实际访问，以展示他与人民的友谊。 海报帮助宣传了这个邪教，在这里，他被视为真正的前台。 毛泽东在文化革命背后的个人目的是为了加强他自己在共产党内的地位。 毛主席徽章为人们提供了一种 "拥有 "邪教并展示其忠诚的方式。
